main.description: Set a member's full role set, replacing whatever roles they previously held. Requires service-auth. Requires the `role.assign` action, bounded by the roles the caller may assign: every role being added or removed must be one the caller's own roles are permitted to assign, per the community's permissions record.

member.description: DID of the member whose roles to set.

roles.description: Record keys of the roles the member should hold.

errors.name: RoleNotAssignable
errors.description: The caller is not permitted to assign or revoke one of the given roles.

errors.name: MemberNotFound
errors.description: The given DID is not a member of the community.
